Icons used inline (as SVG paths) in index.html for the LinkedIn / GitHub buttons.

- LinkedIn square logo: Font Awesome Free 7.3.1, brands/linkedin (npm `@fortawesome/free-brands-svg-icons`).
  Icons: CC BY 4.0 - https://fontawesome.com/license/free  (attribution: "Font Awesome Free by Fonticons, Inc."). See LICENSE-fontawesome.txt.
  Note: this is a stand-in glyph. LinkedIn's brand rules ask for its official logo asset (https://brand.linkedin.com); replace the <svg> in index.html when it is available.
- GitHub mark: Primer Octicons 19.42.0, mark-github-16 (npm `@primer/octicons`). MIT. See LICENSE-octicons.txt.
